create_Receptacle_instance: create a Receptacle instance with a DictConfig, receptacle ID, and icon file path
call_Receptacle_plot: call the Receptacle plot method to render the receptacle icon with placeholders on a matplotlib axes
call_Receptacle_get_icon: call the Receptacle get_icon method to load, resize, and optionally tint the receptacle icon image
call_Receptacle_set_placeholder_position: call set_placeholder_positions on a Receptacle to compute center and top placeholder coordinates from an icon and origin
call_calculate_placeholder_heights: call calculate_placeholder_heights on a PIL image to derive center and top height values from alpha channel data
